tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Convexity of the pinching region] For each $x,t$, the fiber $Z(x,t)$ of the pinching region is a convex subset of $\Sym ^2(\wedge ^2T_x^*M)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Let $f_t(x)=x(\log x+\log (1+t)-3)$ and let $\xi (t)>1/(1+t)$ be the second solution of $f_t(x)=-3/(1+t)$. On $[\xi (t),\infty )$, $f_t'>0$ and $f_t''>0$, so the associated $(S,X)$ region is convex. Since the smallest eigenvalue is convex, $X=\max (-\nu ,0)$ is concave, which proves convexity of the inverse image.

□
